contained.evidence: CLI not installed (`command -v kimi kimicode kimi-cli` finds nothing). Runner source only; nothing executed.

runnerEvidence.finding: Spawns `kimi --print --output-format stream-json [--skills-dir <dir>] [--session <id> | --agent-file <f>] [--model m]` with env = process.env (minus ambient ANTHROPIC_* keys) + args.env + KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FLAG; the runner sets neither HOME nor any config dir, cwd = args.cwd.

readUsageDelta() reads the usage wire file from `env.KIMI_CODE_HOME || process.env.KIMI_CODE_HOME || os.homedir()/.kimi-code` + /sessions. So the runner already treats KIMI_CODE_HOME as the data dir and honours it when passed in args.env; with a private HOME alone the runner process (whose os.homedir() is the real home) would read the wrong place, so KIMI_CODE_HOME must be set explicitly.

notes: No hard-coded absolute path in the runner; the only fallback is the host process's own homedir()/.kimi-code.
Transcripts, wire logs and session state live under $KIMI_CODE_HOME/sessions per the runner's own header comment; auth location unknown without the CLI (not recorded by the runner).
Registry entry should be marked unverified until a host with kimi installed runs probe.mjs.
